subject: Computer Networking
title: Web Accessibility
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Web Accessibility.

hook.text: One billion people have disabilities. If your site isn't accessible, you've locked out 15% of humanity.

buildup.text: WCAG defines accessibility standards. Perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust — four principles.

discovery.text: Alt text describes images for screen readers. ARIA labels add context to interactive elements.

twist.text: Accessibility helps everyone. Captions help in noisy rooms. Keyboard navigation helps power users too.

climax.text: Legal mandates like ADA and EAA require accessible websites. Lawsuits against inaccessible sites are rising.

punchline.text: Accessible web is better web. Design for all, benefit everyone.

details.summary: Web accessibility ensures websites work for people with disabilities, including visual, auditory, motor, and cognitive impairments. WCAG guidelines define standards for accessible design. Semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, and color contrast are essential accessibility techniques.
details.whyItMatters: About 15 percent of the world's population has a disability. Accessible web design ensures these users can fully participate in the digital world and is legally required in many jurisdictions.
takeaways: WCAG provides testable guidelines for web accessibility
Semantic HTML and ARIA provide meaning for screen readers
Keyboard navigation must work for all interactive elements

faq.question: What is WCAG accessibility?
faq.answer: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines are the international standard for web accessibility published by W3C. WCAG defines success criteria at three levels: A, AA, and AAA. Level AA is the standard most laws and policies require.

faq.question: How does a screen reader use a web page?
faq.answer: Screen readers interpret the DOM and ARIA attributes to create an audio representation of the page. Headings provide structure for navigation. Alt text describes images. Labels identify form fields. Landmark roles like main and navigation help users jump between page sections efficiently.
